title: dioscorea triphylla var. mollissima
intro: Dioscorea triphylla var. mollissima, commonly known as Chinese yam, is a type of yam native to China and other parts of Asia. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health conditions due to its health benefits, which include promoting digestive health, reducing inflammation, and improving blood sugar regulation. The therapeutic actions of Chinese yam are attributed to its ability to stimulate the digestive system, calm the nervous system, and nourish the body with essential nutrients. The bioactive constituents of Chinese yam include diosgenin, a plant sterol with anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, as well as other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
